thread:
Morgan: quick check — savings plan renewal window is in 9 days for eu-west. we have weird usage tilt: dev is spiking on a100, prod mostly p4d. raw report: https://billing.example/summary/1902 :eyes:
Raj: can you paste the utilization numbers?
Morgan: sure. 30d utilization by family: p4d 78%, a100 42%, t4 12%. overall SP coverage 61%.
Lin: low a100 util seems like dev env being noisy — we left some long-running jobs on.
Ella: are those dev jobs easily movable to spot/dedicated burst?
Morgan: mostly nightly evals that can be batched. also some long notebook sessions.
Raj: question: do we renew eu-west with single SavingsPlan for GPUs or split by family/term? AWS pricing sketch shows 1yr-cc reduces by ~16%, 3yr-cc ~30%.
OpsLead: prefer not to overcommit P4d in EU unless we can guarantee prod lanes. we saw last quarter a 10% emergency burst to us-west that used EU fallback.
billing-bot: automated note: upcoming commitments expiring: sp-6793 (eu-west, gpu-family: mixed) expires 190303, projected monthly delta $22k if not renewed.
Morgan: my proposal: run a dry-run consolidation — convert mixed SP into two focused commitments: p4d-heavy (prod) + a100/other (dev). simulate with 6/12/36 month terms and show net delta.
Lin: +1. also add a convert-to-RI option for any steady a100 usage — might be cheaper for 3yr all upfront.
Raj: can we do a quick script to estimate effective coverage after swapping? I can hack something but want to avoid manual Excel.
Morgan: pasted a tiny snippet I used last time:
```
aws ce get-reservation-utilization --time-period Start=2025-12-01,End=2026-01-31 --filter "{"Dimensions":{"Key":"SERVICE","Values":["AmazonEC2"]}}"
# then join with reservation inventory csv
```
Ella: nice. also check "orphaned reservations" — we had a few that are children of resv-sku mismatch last year. those kill utilization numbers.
Raj: I exported a quick CSV of instance-hours by region+instance-type. attaching: (link)
Morgan: looked at CSV: 10% of a100 hours are from a single developer sandbox (linus-dev). we should tag/notify owner and consider auto-shutdown policy.
Lin: guilty — that's my sandbox. I'll clean up and add auto-stop.
OpsLead: action items: 1) Morgan + Raj run consolidation dry-run and post cost delta by EOD tomorrow. 2) Lin to cleanup sandbox and enable auto-stop (snooze 24h). 3) Ella to scan reservations inventory for mismatches and list orphaned RIs by 1902960000.
Morgan: quick numbers expectation: if we split, p4d commit ~85% prod usage -> saves ~18% vs on-demand, a100/dev mixed commit saves ~10% but risk of underutilization.
Ella: also consider regional swap — shift small portion of a100 commitment to eu-central if usage there has headroom. but that's a migration ops cost.
Raj: ack. I'll prototype the script and share results in this thread. if numbers look solid we should present to finance for 1yr-cc commit and plan a 3yr for stable p4d later.
billing-bot: projected impact table attached (automated): potential monthly savings range $12k-$30k depending on term and split.
Morgan: cool. @OpsLead can you approve a short freeze window for making the purchase if numbers match?
OpsLead: yes, allow a 2-hour procurement window next Thursday. make sure finance tag is added. :white_check_mark:
Raj: starting script now, will ping when CSV ready.
Lin: cleaning sandbox now, will post completion. :rocket:
Ella: running reservation inventory scan, will post orphan list in ~1h.
Morgan: thanks all. keeping the runbook simple: dry-run -> orphan cleanup -> owner notif -> commit decision.
Raj: CSV uploaded: https://files.example/ri-dryrun/190295-csv
Morgan: saw it, starting analysis. if anyone sees unexpected elb network egress cost bumps during commit window flag it here.
Lin: done — sandbox stopped and auto-stop set.
Ella: orphan scan: found 3 mismatched reservations (eu-west) and one stale convertible RI. listing in doc: https://docs.example/ri-orphans/190295
Raj: initial simulation: splitting into p4d-focused 1yr-cc + dev mixed 1yr reduces monthly spend by estimated $14.2k with 6% reduction in coverage variance. posting full table soon.
Morgan: if final looks within expectations we'll queue purchase next Thurs during the freeze window. thanks team. :thumbsup:
